 Order

By this petition, petitioners herein are seeking a direction upon respondent nos. 1 to 5 to handover the vacant possession of the land to the petitioners or in the alternative, to place the indent for acquisition of the land under the Requisition & Acquisition of Immovable Property Act,
1952 read with Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 with a further direction to respondent no. 6 to complete the acquisition proceedings by adhering to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
